results.system_description: J₁–J₂ Heisenberg, 20 × 20 · J₂/J₁ = 0.5 · periodic · Sz = 0. H = J1 sum_<ij> S_i · S_j + J2 sum_<<ij>> S_i · S_j; spin-1/2 operators S; J1 = 1; J2 = 0.5
results.source_location: Sec. 'J1-J2 Heisenberg Square Lattice' (sec:square_lattice), text ('no symmetry [-0.496375(1)], translational symmetry [-0.496698(1)], and full point-group (C4v) symmetry [-0.496732(1)]'); points of Fig. fig:J1J2_square
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the spatial-attention ViT on the 20 × 20 periodic cluster at J2/J1 = 0.5; the zero-variance extrapolation -0.49684(1) is excluded.
results.notes: Spin-1/2 operators, periodic boundary conditions, J2/J1 = 0.5 (sec:square_lattice). The magnetization sector is not stated.
